lovers.songTitle: One of Us Cannot Be Wrong
lovers.line: He taught that the duty of lovers
stanza: I heard of a saint who had loved you
So I studied all night in his school
He taught that the duty of lovers
Is to tarnish the golden rule
And just when I was sure that his teachings were pure
He drowned himself in the pool
His body is gone, but back here on the lawn
His spirit continues to drool

lovers.line: 'Cause long words widen gaps between lovers
stanza: But let's not talk this through, I used to
'Cause long words widen gaps between lovers
We ought to be lone, my home's your own
Until we have each other, we're strangers

lovers.line: But of all these friends and lovers
stanza: But of all these friends and lovers
There is no one compares with you (Ooh, ooh, ooh)
And these memories lose their meaning
When I think of love as something new (Ooh, ooh, ooh)

lovers.line: In the calling out to one another of the lovers
stanza: In the calling out to one another of the lovers
Up and down the strand
In the sound of the waves and the cries
Of the seagulls circling the sand
In the fragments of the songs
Carried down the wind from some radio
In the murmuring of the city in the distance
Ominous and low

lovers.line: I don't go in for your star-crossed lovers
stanza: I don't believe everything happens for a reason
To us romantics out here, that amounts to high treason
I don't go in for your star-crossed lovers
In the heart of a skeptic, there's a question that still hovers near
Old fools, dancing
Old rules take a backseat to new romancing
Long drives, flowers
Old fools, new lovers
Rock on, ancient queen
Follow those who pale in your shadow
Rulers make bad lovers
You better put your kingdom up for sale, up for sale

lovers.line: All fuckin' with our lovers' heads generation (Look out, lovers)
stanza: We're L-O-V-E-L-E-S-S generation
L-O-V-E-L-E-S-S (Look out, lovers) generation
All fuckin' with our lovers' heads generation (Look out, lovers)

lovers.line: But still it's been written, a history of lovers
stanza: Some say they saw in me innocent poetry
Some say they'll never be certain
But still it's been written, a history of lovers
In giving, and taking, and ink
When we were strangers
I watched you from afar
When we were lovers
I loved you with all my heart

lovers.line: We saw the lovers, the modern lovers
lovers.linePrev: And we've got candlesticks and lots of cocktail sticks
lovers.lineNext: And they looked very good, they looked as if they could

lovers.songTitle: I Guess That’s Why They Call It the Blues
stanza: (Laughing like children, living like lovers)
And I guess that's why they call it the blues
(Laughing like children, living like lovers)
And I guess that's why they call it the blues
And I guess that's why they call it the blues
